title: Geometric compatibility of native compact-support coefficient transitions
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, c=(j,p) any compactification X to Y, and M any derived coefficient system on X [def-weil-compactifications-refinements, def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. For n<=m let tau be the actual horizontal coefficient transition [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition], epsilon the specified native compact-support evaluation [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation], and chi the normalized compact-support coefficient restriction square [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]. Then tau_Y((J followed by P)M) followed by Res_q(epsilon_n) equals epsilon_m followed by F_m(tau_X M) followed by chi on M_n. This concerns arbitrary systems, without a completed input, reduction functor, scalar linearity, or a tower-existence assertion.

proof.text: Use the normalized native direct-image transition square on the native open extension of M. Expand the specified composite evaluation into its direct-image factor and open factor.

Move the open evaluation through the direct-image coefficient comparison using naturality of sfDerivedImageRestriction. The two adjacent direct-image maps now combine into the direct image of the open transition square.

Substitute the native open transition square and distribute direct image over composition. By definition sfCompactSupportRestriction is precisely the open square followed by the direct-image square; associativity yields the unchanged equation.

theorem compactSupportNativeSystemTransition
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (M : coefficientSequenceDerived.{u, u} l E X) :
    (compactSupportCoefficientTransition l E Y h).app
        ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.J (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) c.i ⋙
          ProEtale.VaryingRing.P (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
            (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) c.g).obj M) ≫
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y
        (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((compactSupportSystemEvaluation l E c n).hom.app M) =
    (compactSupportSystemEvaluation l E c m).hom.app M ≫
      (sfIntrinsicCompactSupport c (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (m + 1))).map
        ((compactSupportCoefficientTransition l E X h).app M) ≫
      (sfCompactSupportRestriction c (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).hom.app
        ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).obj M)
